================================================================================
Empty new template with a comment closed by end new (sloplint SC-ENDNEW)
================================================================================

trait Foo
val foo =
  new Foo:
    // comment
  end new

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (trait_definition
    (identifier))
  (val_definition
    (identifier)
    (indented_block
      (instance_expression
        (type_identifier)
        (comment)
        (end_marker)))))

================================================================================
Non-empty new template closed by end new (control)
================================================================================

trait Foo
val foo =
  new Foo:
    val x = 1
  end new

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (trait_definition
    (identifier))
  (val_definition
    (identifier)
    (indented_block
      (instance_expression
        (type_identifier)
        (template_body
          (val_definition
            (identifier)
            (integer_literal)))
        (end_marker)))))

================================================================================
Empty new template without end new stays an error (control)
================================================================================

object T:
  trait A:
    val x = new Foo:
  val y = 2
  trait Foo

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (object_definition
    (identifier)
    (template_body
      (trait_definition
        (identifier)
        (template_body
          (val_definition
            (identifier)
            (instance_expression
              (type_identifier)))
          (ERROR)))
      (val_definition
        (identifier)
        (integer_literal))
      (trait_definition
        (identifier)))))

================================================================================
Empty new template closed by end new (sloplint SC-ENDNEW)
================================================================================

trait Foo
val foo =
  new Foo:
  end new

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (trait_definition
    (identifier))
  (val_definition
    (identifier)
    (indented_block
      (instance_expression
        (type_identifier)
        (end_marker)))))
